allocation_complete.reason: The BMS-side contribution (permitted discharge power, pack overcurrent protection) is covered by the two allocated requirements.

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_POWER_DERATING and BMS_REQ_PACK_OVERCURRENT are tagged interface and exist only in BEV products like the element.

no_value_copy.reason: No derating temperatures or 350 A / 100 ms value is restated.

parent_fit.reason: Publishes the permitted discharge power the vehicle traction limit must respect, a distinct BMS part of REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT.

variant_consistency.reason: bms folder (bev) is stronger than the ungated REQ_TRACTION_POWER_LIMIT.
